title: Domain cluster allocation policy note
brief: Clarify strategic domain-cluster allocation for corporate/sector shards: the initial one-sector-one-cluster index is not enough to reflect real demand, especially in IT. Document a reserved multi-cluster IT allocation direction and the tradeoff around 255 rentable domain_lo slots per base cluster, without changing runtime domain_index.rs in this slice.

delegations.prompt_summary: Document owner decision in CONCEPT_ROADMAP and DOMAINS; no code/runtime change.
Review domain-cluster allocation policy note for consistency with domain_hi/domain_lo model and V4/V5 backlog boundaries.

notes:
Owner noted that corporate domain clusters were originally planned by industry count, which likely under-represents real demand for IT. This slice documents a strategic reserve policy: allocate part of reserved corporate/sector clusters, possibly around 16, to IT subclusters, each with up to 255 rentable domain_lo values after service/reserved slots. Runtime domain index changes are deferred.

pwm-review (2026-05-16): PASS_WITH_NITS. Docs align domain_hi=cluster/shard identity and domain_lo=selector/rentable namespace; sector table stays runtime SoT until ADR; explicit deferral of domain_index.rs. Nit about clarifying "up to 255" was auto-closed in docs.
